capital_allocation_activity: Our last share repurchase under this authorization occurred in Q1 2021, and no shares were repurchased during the fiscal year ending December 27, 2025.
As we will continue to consolidate the results of Mobileye, the impact of their share repurchase was eliminated in our Consolidated Financial Statements.
liquidity_notes: Recent 10-Q disclosures discuss liquidity needs and management's view of cash flow adequacy.
